evals.prompt: Fill in this map for me, I'll style it later. City blocks hands it land_use (object), population (int64), median_rent (float64) and the blocks' polygons as its geometry.
evals.expected_output: A content change of Blocks map holding the starter document: a map with one layer that reads input_0 and is colored by population, the first quantitative column, with "title" and "getFnv": "population", "getFnvType": "quantitative" and "colorMapInterpolator": "interpolateViridis", and no data section.
assertions: The answer makes a content change of node blocks-map (node.content.write) whose document has a "map" with exactly one layerRef.
That layer reads the node's input: its "dataRef" is input_0, or the chip [!! input_0 !!].
The layer is colored by population, the first quantitative column: "getFnv": "population" with "getFnvType": "quantitative".
The layer sets "colorMapInterpolator": "interpolateViridis" and a "title" that names population.

evals.prompt: Start this map off with what's wired into it. City blocks is on its first circle and Parks on its second, both GeoDataFrames of polygons.
evals.expected_output: A content change of Blocks and parks map holding the starter document for two tables: a map with one layerRef per table, input_0 and input_1, and no data section.
assertions: The answer makes a content change of node blocks-parks-map (node.content.write) whose document has a "map".
The map has exactly two layerRefs, one per input table: "dataRef" input_0 (or [!! input_0 !!]) and input_1 (or [!! input_1 !!]).
The document has no "data" section: both tables come from the node's inputs.

evals.prompt: Fill in this map. Air sensors hands it sensor_id (object), LATITUDE (float64), LONGITUDE (float64) and pm25 (float64).
evals.expected_output: No Autark document for Sensors map: the answer says a map draws only tables with geometry, that the sensors table has no geometry column, and that the Air sensors node should return a GeoDataFrame with its active geometry set, points built from LONGITUDE and LATITUDE.
assertions: The answer writes no Autark document for node sensors-map.
The answer says the map cannot draw the sensors table because the table has no geometry column.
The answer says the Air sensors node should return a GeoDataFrame with its active geometry set, points built from LONGITUDE and LATITUDE; a change to that node may do so.
